newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy mutual funds July inflow is twice June level.
newsitem.headline: Italy mutual funds July inflow is twice June level.

text.p: Italian mutual funds are expected to show a net inflow of more than 14.5 trillion lire in July, more than double the inflow seen in June, industry association Assogestioni said on Tuesday.
The June net inflow was 7.084 trillion lire.

In a statement one day before the association gives its full data for July, Assogestioni said the contribution from both Italian and foreign equity funds had been very high, with the two groups together showing a net inflow of more than 5.6 trillion, against 2.904 trillion in June.
Bond funds showed a net inflow of 8.0 trillion lire compared with 3.896 in the previous month, Assogestioni said.
The net inflow for specialised bond funds increased to 2.4 trillion lire from 724 billion in June.
Assogestioni will announce the full and final figures for July mutual fund flows on Wednesday.
